layers.process: Coiba National Park: since 1 July 2022 MiAmbiente says all charges for the park are paid at its finance offices (head office or the Veraguas regional office) or by bank transfer, not in cash at the park. Without the payment slip you are not allowed in, and every visitor must carry ID or a passport so the nationality matches the payment. After paying, the slip goes to the park's administration at Gambute, Coiba island, to finish admission. The notice dates from 2022; check it is still current.

sources.title: MiAMBIENTE anuncia cambios en el sistema de pagos para ingreso al PN Coiba

zone-requirements.note: Coiba National Park only. Fee amounts not read.
